data.gender_notes: Hair is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, 'Hair' refers to locks or strands of hair. This name carries a classic and timeless appeal. The name Hair carries the meaning “Locks of hair” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hair usually hope their child will grow to embody locks of hair and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Hair belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Locks of hair.”

in_arabic.name: شعر
in_arabic.meaning: شعر الرأس هو جزء من الجسم
in_arabic.long_meaning: شعر الرأس هو جزء من الجسم الإنسان، وله أهمية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يُعتبر جزءًا من جمال الإنسان، ويُشير القرآن الكريم إلى أهمية الحفاظ على الشعر والاهتمام به، كما يُعتبر الشعر جزءًا من التقاليد الإسلامية في الزينة والترتيب

in_urdu.name: بال

This includes taking care of one's hair, which is often an essential aspect of personal identity. In some Muslim cultures, elaborate hairstyles and adornments have been traditions passed down through generations.
